# mmx

> mmx is a local Rust CLI where a human edits an AI agent's Mermaid diagram directly on the rendered picture (`mmx serve`), and the agent receives exactly what changed as a structured JSON diff (`mmx wait`) and answers by editing the diagram with a note (`mmx render --note`, `mmx note`). Model-agnostic; works with any agent that can run a CLI.

## Agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Eastsidegunn/mmx/blob/main/AGENTS.md): step-by-step setup and the conversation loop for an AI agent
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Eastsidegunn/mmx/blob/main/skills/mmx/SKILL.md): the full agent contract (turn routine, exit codes, error recovery)
- [diff-schema.md](https://github.com/Eastsidegunn/mmx/blob/main/skills/mmx/references/diff-schema.md): every field of diff.json (v2) and state.json
- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/Eastsidegunn/mmx/blob/main/INSTALL.md): environment probing and user-local install paths

## Humans
